verdict.rationale: Delegated third-party access, such as power-of-attorney or tax-information authorization forms, representative roles, and signature rules, is a fair question for a state tax agency. The evidence pack contains nothing on it. The cited material covers filing, payments, license renewal and Request for Change forms for name and address updates, none of which define what a representative may or may not do. The portal probe only shows an authenticated session exists, not any published delegation model.
